assumptions.statement: The submitted site boundary and three key areas are provisional_constraint geometries (official_boundary=false) derived from brief/site-package/geometry/provisional_boundaries.geojson. They are used only for proposal generation, self-check, visualisation and design discussion.
assumptions.impact: All spatial metrics (site_area_sqm, green_ratio, public_space_ratio, building_footprint_area_sqm, area fields) are provisional design-layer calculations, not official redlines or precise-area bases. They must be recalculated after official polygons are supplied.

assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, flood-control, fire-safety, heritage-protection and engineering constraints are not present in the public site package.
assumptions.impact: Any conclusion that depends on missing official controls is downgraded to a pending/awaiting-confirmation item rather than a statutory finding. FAR, building height, density, setbacks and road-redline values remain status=unknown until official controls arrive.

assumptions.statement: Annual activities, developer-community operations, scenario-open operations, public experience routes and international promotion mechanisms are conceptual suggestions for professional teams to deepen.
assumptions.impact: These are not confirmed government activities, investment commitments, or approved operations. Responsible parties, permits, funding and governance must be established before implementation.
